hook: Boosting helper T cells before they reach the tumor made immunotherapy work better in colorectal cancer mice.
hook_turn: before they reach the tumor made immunotherapy work better in colorectal cancer mice.
summary: Imaging of patient tumors showed helper-T-cell-rich immune neighborhoods in tumors that respond to anti-PD-1 therapy, but not in those that resist it. In mouse models of resistant tumors, adding an OX40 agonist to PD-1 blockade expanded early helper T cells in lymph nodes and slowed tumor growth. The therapeutic effect was shown only in mice.
title: Differentiation of stem-like CD4+ T cells modulates early effector responses in colorectal cancer.
